primary_source: World Health Organization (WHO) Child Growth Standards - expanded z-score tables for constructing national health cards
data_provenance_note: LMS constants were reconstructed from the generated tables of the open-source who-growth-standards dataset, whose generator downloads the WHO expanded XLSX tables from cdn.who.int. Package integrity was checked locally against expected WHO ranges, known LMS anchor values, formula constraints, and row counts.
clinical_notice: Reference data for growth monitoring support. These curves do not by themselves establish a diagnosis and do not replace assessment by qualified health personnel.
